# BDSM Test

> BDSM Test is an online testing tool that helps users explore and understand their preferences, roles, and interests in the BDSM domain. The test provides detailed personal analysis results.

We offer a series of professionally designed questionnaires and tests to help users understand their tendencies in various aspects of BDSM. Test results are confidential and for personal reference only.

## Core Content
- [Tests](https://mybdsmtest.org/tests): Including full tests and short versions to help users understand BDSM preferences
- [Results Analysis](https://mybdsmtest.org/results): Detailed explanations of various roles and preferences
- [Resource Center](https://mybdsmtest.org/resources): BDSM-related educational content and safe practice guidelines

## Common Resources
- [FAQ](https://mybdsmtest.org/faq): Answers to user questions about tests and results
- [Contact Information](https://mybdsmtest.org/contact): Feedback and support channels

## Optional
- [About Us](https://mybdsmtest.org/about): Website philosophy and team introduction
- [Terms of Use](https://mybdsmtest.org/terms): Website usage rules and privacy policy
